title: PPTX with a hidden slide, ru markers
description: Three slides; slide 2 is hidden. Every slide, the hidden one included, gets its own page anchor, so pages is 3. The hidden slide stays in the text with its marker and does not change extraction. Any office file is withheld from agents (`office`). Markers in `ru`: the current strings, byte for byte. The slide content is English.
